description: Write to the team notebook: status, observations, measurements, results, environment state (e.g. 'lab box is busy until 14:00', 'eval run: precision 0.82', 'image built locally, not in the registry'). Use this instead of decision_log for anything that is a fact about the current state rather than a choice the team must follow. Notes from the last 24h are shown to every agent.

key.description: Reuse a key to update a running note (e.g. "lab-status"); omit for a one-off note

name: note_add
